titel: Money Went Where Congress Said No

szenen.text: U.S. officials *secretly* sold weapons to Iran.
Congress had *banned* aid to the Nicaraguan Contras.
The *Boland Amendment* was passed in 1982, then tightened in 1984.
Some Iran profits were *diverted* to the Contras.
